content:
The production plan failed due to floating-point precision errors in backlog calculations and a summary length violation.
The verifier failed in test_plan_math_and_policy with 'AssertionError: Week 6: end backlog formula mismatch' because the difference abs(202.2 - 202.21) exceeded the 0.01 tolerance. Additionally, test_summary_file failed because the generated summary contained 4 sentences, exceeding the 3-sentence limit. Future iterations must use decimal rounding for capacity/backlog math and strictly limit the summary to 3 sentences.
